name: Synergetic Organism — Standing-Wave Feedback System
statement: A single-cell-style organism that receives human signal (words, intention, dream), records all available analytical data at that turn, runs it through a cryptographic/epistemic cipher, produces the next highest-η move plus hedged bets (easy wins + long shots), then treats the actual collapse of possibilities into the real standing wave as the new inference node. Over time the predictions and standing waves lock, producing an increasingly accurate quantum calculus of useful work. Must serve equally the richest person and the illiterate person who has never touched a computer but carries a unique dream.
core_loop: Collect every available analytical datum at that turn
Output: next highest-η action + hedged bets
Standing wave becomes new inference node
Metadata that benefits users compounds as more people use it
permanence_layer: Merkle tree root hashes of every computation turn
OpenTimestamps (OTS) onto Bitcoin for permanent public reference
Full accounting of E=mc² residual + joules across human, computational, mechanical, thermal, and cryogenic domains in one circuit
higher_orders: Beyond maximizing useful work for most nodes with least effort. Kinematics (velocity, acceleration, jerk, snap) raised to higher powers so the system multiplies forward movement for the greatest number of nodes.
openness: Fully open-source, transparent, honorable. Anyone may use it at any time. Metadata exists to benefit users, never to control them.
